subject: Evidence pack and request to trigger fallback for model-11c p95 regression
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@luminex.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observed p95 regression for model-11c — initial evidence

Evelyn / Markus —

Heads-up: our infra alarms picked up a sustained p95 latency uptick for model-11c serving Luminex over the last 6 hours. Key points: 
- Baseline p95 (last 7d): ~220ms
- Current p95 (last 6h): ~480ms (service time only)
- Error rate: unchanged (0.4%) — not an obvious request spike
- Affected variant: model-11c / v11c-20250615 (recent patch deployed to improve kernel packing)

I've attached a short perf export (11c_perf_report.csv) and a sampled trace set (error_trace_log.txt). The traces show increased token-time on longer prompts (seq > 512) and a change in kernel selection around the new runtime build. Early hypothesis: quantization-related code path change leading to degraded vectorized kernels for long sequences.

Customer impact: Luminex reports a 12% increase in perceived latency for their product search flows; they're asking for immediate mitigation (they're on Dedicated pool with reserved capacity). Tim, thanks for flagging on your side — customers are seeing p95 regressions in their telemetry as well.

Recommended immediate actions we should consider (please advise):
1) Trigger traffic split fallback to v11c-20250520 (pre-patch) for Luminex only.
2) Short-term capacity bump on their dedicated pool while we investigate.
3) Prepare SLA exception request draft to cover the delta window if fallback is required.

I can pull the rollback split now if you want me to execute (I have runbook access). Attaching the perf CSV and a quick SLO delta summary.

- Ben

--
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0137
[attachment: 11c_perf_report.csv] [attachment: error_trace_log.txt]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@luminex.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed p95 regression for model-11c — initial evidence

Thanks Ben — good initial notes.

Quick asks before we decide to trigger a fallback: 
- Can you quantify the expected p95 improvement if we switch back to v11c-20250520 (ballpark from canary or earlier runs)? Put the numbers (current vs expected) in the SLO delta summary.
- Confirm whether the degradations are isolated to long sequences >512 and a specific GPU type (nvidia-a100 vs a2).
- Attach the canary run id / build hash for v11c-20250615 that introduced the kernel change.

If the expected p95 reduction is >150ms and impact is limited to Luminex traffic, I'm inclined to authorize a targeted fallback. We will still need an SLA exception note for Luminex for the window; please draft one and include proposed wording I can approve to send to legal/customer success.

Tim — please share any customer-side traces or SLO observations you have (one-liner summary will do) so we have a unified view when we talk to the customer.

Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart | Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@luminex.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed p95 regression for model-11c — initial evidence

Evelyn —

Quick follow-up with the numbers and artifacts you asked for. Summary first, details below and attached.

Summary (from canary and controlled backtest):
- v11c-20250615 current p95 (long-seq subset): ~480ms
- v11c-20250520 baseline p95 (long-seq subset): ~210ms
- Estimated delta if we fallback for Luminex: ~-270ms p95 (measured in canary traffic)
- Scope: issue reproduces on a100 and t4, more pronounced on a100 when sequence length >512

Root cause hypothesis: a change in the kernel dispatch in v11c-20250615 causes the runtime to select a fallback scalar kernel for certain attention window sizes when a particular quantization pattern is present. This was not caught in perf smoke because canaries used truncated prompts.

Attached files: 11c_perf_report.csv (includes canary vs baseline p95 per seq bucket), slo_delta_summary.pdf (SLO deltas + crafted SLA-exception wording draft), error_trace_log.txt (sampled traces with kernel selection flags).

Action recommendation (short):
1) Authorize targeted traffic split rollback for Luminex to v11c-20250520 (100% Luminex traffic) — I can enact traffic rules now.
2) Open infra change ticket to revert the kernel-dispatch patch in a staging-only branch for revalidation.
3) Send tentative SLA exception wording to Legal & CS: we propose a goodwill credit equal to 5% of June usage for Luminex if they experience any user-facing errors tied to the regression window. Wording is in the SLO PDF.

If you approve, I'll: enact traffic split, open the infra ticket (TICKET-98123), and draft the customer-facing note for your signature.

- Ben

--
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: 11c_perf_report.csv] [attachment: slo_delta_summary.pdf] [attachment: error_trace_log.txt]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@luminex.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed p95 regression for model-11c — initial evidence

Thanks for the clear data and recommendations. I have reviewed the SLO delta and the perf CSV. Given the measured ~270ms improvement on canary and the limited blast radius (single customer Dedicated pool), I authorize the targeted fallback and the SLA exception draft as follows:

Authorization:
- Approve targeted traffic split: route 100% of Luminex production traffic back to v11c-20250520 immediately. Ben, please execute the rollback traffic rule and confirm when active.
- Approve opening service ticket TICKET-98123 to revert the kernel-dispatch change in a staging branch. Eng should aim for a mitigated build and a follow-up canary in 48h.
- Approve provisional SLA exception language in slo_delta_summary.pdf. Legal/CS may adjust, but we can proactively notify Luminex with a proposed 5% goodwill credit for June usage and a commitment to a follow-up post-mortem.

Operational notes:
- CS should coordinate a short maintenance window notification to the Luminex ops team (Tim) once the split is in place.
- Infra: please add a temporary autoscale +10% to the Dedicated pool for the duration of the fallback to avoid cold-path impact.

Ben: take the action items. Evelyn: if you can approve the customer note, I'll sign-off and loop Legal.

Markus
